title: 24 Sales Calls for an AI Productivity Platform
challenge: An early-stage AI SaaS company needed initial traction among B2B decision-makers. While the product attracted interest, its founders had no systematic approach to building a pipeline.
solution: Myntmore developed a founder-led demand generation strategy. We identified high-fit use cases, created content demonstrating practical AI workflows and launched targeted outreach to founders, revenue leaders and operations teams.
results: A defined outbound process for future scaling.
